description: This is a unit test class for the LeavePeriodHistoryService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The file contains test methods that verify the functionality of generating and retrieving leave period histories based on different configurations, dates, and calendar considerations.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing LeavePeriodHistoryService related functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and prepares the LeavePeriodService instance with test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDateIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that calling getGeneratedLeavePeriodList without parameters throws a ServiceException.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests generation of leave periods when the start date is set to Jan 1, 2010, verifying the output spans multiple years including dynamically extending to the current year.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1st
methods.description: Similar to the previous, but with a different initial fixture setup, verifying leave period ranges.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListForLeapYear
methods.description: Intended to test leap-year handling for March 1st start month, but the method is disabled (not run) as indicated by the 'x' prefix.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1stAnd2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests multiple historical leave period entries with different creation dates to verify the cumulative list generation.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListCase1
methods.description: Another disabled test case meant to verify correct leave period ranges over several years with multiple start dates.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Checks correct retrieval of the current leave period for specific sample dates, given the leave period history.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodArrayToYmdArray
methods.description: Converts an array of LeavePeriod objects into an array of date range strings in 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodToArray
methods.description: Converts a single LeavePeriod object into a two-element array containing start and end dates.

methods.name: getLastDayInFebruary
methods.description: Helper method to determine the last day of February for a given year, accounting for leap years.
